hcdf.name: cogni-humanoid-mobile-base
hcdf.description: CogniPilot humanoid mobile base: S32N79 + E810 spine, AGX Thor compute, dual 802.3dm 7-DOF arms, S32J100 base zone, i.MX95 head, TSN backbone with MACsec
hcdf.author: CogniPilot Foundation

comp.name: agx-thor
comp.description: NVIDIA AGX Thor SoC: perception, planning, ML inference. 2x 25G MGBE uplinks to S32N79.

comp.name: s32n79
comp.description: NXP S32N79: central motion control, CNC agent, integrated TSN switch. Intel E810 on PCIe for 25G uplink to AGX Thor.

comp.name: s32j100
comp.description: NXP S32J100: base zone controller. Bridges Ethernet to CAN-FD (wheels, BMS) and base peripherals (lidars, radar, head). Decapsulates 1722+CAN from S32N79.

comp.name: head
comp.description: i.MX95 head unit: display, microphones, user interaction

comp.name: lidar-front
comp.description: NXP SPAD front base lidar: solid-state, 200m range

comp.name: lidar-rear
comp.description: NXP SPAD rear base lidar: solid-state, 200m range

comp.name: radar-4d
comp.description: Cubtek 4D imaging radar: 77GHz FMCW, 120-degree FOV

comp.name: zlac8015d
comp.description: ZLTECH ZLAC8015D v4.0 dual-channel servo controller. Drives 2x ZLLG65ASM250-L hub motors via SIGNAL connectors. CANopen on CAN-FD bus.

comp.name: wheel-left
comp.description: ZLLG65ASM250-L 24V BLDC hub motor (left). 170mm diameter, 2.92 kg, 250W rated.

comp.name: wheel-right
comp.description: ZLLG65ASM250-L 24V BLDC hub motor (right). 170mm diameter, 2.92 kg, 250W rated.

comp.name: caster-fl
comp.description: Front-left passive omni caster wheel

comp.name: caster-fr
comp.description: Front-right passive omni caster wheel

comp.name: bms
comp.description: CogniPilot MR-BMS771: 8S LiFePO4 (~25.6V nominal). CAN-FD. Battery management + power distribution.

comp.name: chassis
comp.description: Mobile base chassis frame: structural root of kinematic tree

comp.name: torso
comp.description: Upper body torso structure: mounts both arm chains

comp.name: mcn1-l
comp.description: Left Motor Control Node 1: Shoulder (3 BLDC motors, yaw, pitch, roll). 802.3dm bridging switch.

comp.name: mcn2-l
comp.description: Left Motor Control Node 2: Elbow (1 BLDC motor)

comp.name: mcn3-l
comp.description: Left Motor Control Node 3: Wrist (2 BLDC motors, pitch, roll) + camera spur port

frame.name: tcp_left
frame.description: Left arm tool center point for end-effector control

comp.name: mcn4-l
comp.description: Left Motor Control Node 4: Dextrous hand (many small BLDC motors for finger articulation)

comp.name: cam-l
comp.description: Left wrist stereo camera: ~7 Gbps raw via 802.3dm upstream to S32N79

comp.name: mcn1-r
comp.description: Right Motor Control Node 1: Shoulder (3 BLDC motors, yaw, pitch, roll)

comp.name: mcn2-r
comp.description: Right Motor Control Node 2: Elbow (1 BLDC motor)

comp.name: mcn3-r
comp.description: Right Motor Control Node 3: Wrist (2 BLDC motors, pitch, roll) + camera spur port

frame.name: tcp_right
frame.description: Right arm tool center point for end-effector control

comp.name: mcn4-r
comp.description: Right Motor Control Node 4: Dextrous hand (many small BLDC motors for finger articulation)

comp.name: cam-r
comp.description: Right wrist stereo camera: ~7 Gbps raw via 802.3dm upstream to S32N79

group.name: left_arm
group.description: Left arm kinematic chain (shoulder to wrist)

group.name: right_arm
group.description: Right arm kinematic chain (shoulder to wrist)

group.name: left_manipulation
group.description: Left arm + hand for manipulation tasks

group.name: right_manipulation
group.description: Right arm + hand for manipulation tasks

group.name: head_group
group.description: Head unit for display and microphone interaction

state.name: home
state.description: Default home position: arms at sides, elbows slightly bent

state.name: transport
state.description: Compact transport position: arms folded tight against torso
